prompt: IMPORTANT: the black cat MUST REMAIN A CAT for the entire shot, in every single frame. It never turns into a person, never becomes a human fighter, never loses its fur, ears, whiskers or tail. There are never two humans facing each other in this shot - it is always a cat facing a man. Plain live television look. No sparks, no fire, no glowing effects, no cartoon effects. Continuous single shot, no cuts, camera completely LOCKED on a tripod with only a tiny tremble; it does NOT zoom, push in, orbit or travel. Bare-knuckle boxing ring, the pre-fight staredown. NOBODY THROWS A SINGLE PUNCH. Timing, follow it exactly: SECONDS 0-2: the giant black cat with bright yellow eyes stands on the left, the bald fighter on the right, the referee between them. The cat stands upright on its hind legs, perfectly still, staring at the man. SECONDS 2-4: the referee steps backwards out of the way and the cat and the fighter step toward each other until they are face to face, the cat's muzzle almost touching the man's face, both filling the middle of the frame. SECONDS 4-8: they hold the staredown. The cat does not blink and does not move, only whiskers and fur move slightly. The man tries to hold the stare, his jaw tightens, he shifts his weight, then he breaks first, looks away and lowers his eyes. The cat slowly blinks once and keeps staring. The cat stays the size of a grown adult human, stays upright on its hind legs and never drops onto all four paws. Shot on a long telephoto lens with shallow depth of field: the two of them sharp, the crowd and the banners out of focus, no letters or logos legible behind the ring. The ring stays exactly as in the first frame. Do not invent or re-spell any text, no gibberish, no logos of any other fight promotion. Photorealistic, correct anatomy, no morphing. Comedic tone, deadpan. Audio: a huge arena crowd murmuring and building, a few whistles, then the crowd starting to laugh and roar. No music, no commentary, no speech.
